description: This is a 3D model of a tufted ottoman. The ottoman appears to be upholstered, with a button-tufted top surface that creates a diamond pattern. The sides of the ottoman are also upholstered and seem to have a slightly rounded or padded appearance. The overall form is compact and cube-like, suggesting it is designed for seating or as a footrest. The lighting in the preview casts soft shadows, highlighting the texture and depth of the tufting. The model is rendered with a subtle grayish-blue hue and is set against a neutral, slightly blurred background, which helps to draw attention to the object itself.
